Turkish · 1,000 words

Turkish words 701–800

Turkish words 701 to 800, by how often they're used, each with its meaning in English, an example sentence and, for verbs, the main forms (he, she or it). 55 of them are taught in the lessons of the course.

Learn them with spaced repetition, Anki-style: open the flashcards. Free, no account needed.

Overview1–100101–200201–300301–400401–500501–600601–700701–800801–900901–1000
  1. 701
    ufakadjective

    small, little, tiny

    Ufak bir sorunumuz var.

    We have a small problem.

    Close to küçük, often for small, unimportant things: ufak bir hata. Ufak tefek = slight (of a person); odds and ends.

    B2First taught in B2 · Unit 9: Everyday colloquial Turkish

  2. 702
    erkenadverb

    early

    Yarın erken kalkmam lazım.

    I have to get up early tomorrow.

    Also an adjective: erken bir saat. The opposite is geç. Erkenden = early on, in good time.

    A2First taught in A2 · Unit 1: The past tense

  3. 703
    hoşça kalphrase

    goodbye (said by the person leaving)

    Hoşça kal, yarın görüşürüz!

    Bye, see you tomorrow!

    Said by the person leaving; the one who stays answers güle güle. To several people, or politely: Hoşça kalın.

    A1First taught in A1 · Unit 1: Letters and sounds

  4. 704
    oluşmakverb

    to form, to be formed; to consist (of: -DAn)

    Takımımız on bir kişiden oluşuyor.

    Our team consists of eleven people.

    aorist oluşur · present oluşuyor · past oluştu · future oluşacak

    -DAn oluşmak = to consist of. Oluşturmak = to form, to make up.

    B1

  5. 705
    yedinumber

    seven

    Bir haftada yedi gün var.

    There are seven days in a week.

    Yedinci = seventh. Yedisinden yetmişine = from seven to seventy: people of all ages.

    A1First taught in A1 · Unit 11: Numbers and time

  6. 706
    işlemekverb

    to commit (a crime, a sin); to process, to work (a material); to embroider

    Bu adam bir suç işledi.

    This man committed a crime.

    aorist işler · present işliyor · past işledi · future işleyecek

    The e becomes i before -(I)yor: işliyor. Suç işlemek = to commit a crime; işlenmiş = processed, worked. Working at a job is çalışmak.

    B2First taught in B2 · Unit 7: Stacked voices

  7. 707
    ağaçnoun

    tree

    Bahçede büyük bir ağaç var.

    There's a big tree in the garden.

    accusative ağacı

    The ç becomes c before a vowel: ağacı. Elma ağacı = apple tree.

    A1First taught in A1 · Unit 8: Definite objects

  8. 708
    duygunoun

    feeling, emotion

    Duygularını anlatmak kolay değil.

    It isn't easy to talk about your feelings.

    Duygusal = emotional, sentimental. His is close in meaning.

    B1First taught in B1 · Unit 8: Converbs II: the more, whenever, because

  9. 709
    taşnoun

    stone, rock

    Çocuk denize taş attı.

    The child threw a stone into the sea.

    A stone and stone as a material: taş ev (stone house). In games, a piece or a tile: okey taşı.

    B1First taught in B1 · Unit 10: Passive and reflexive

  10. 710
    eşyanoun

    things, belongings; furniture

    Eşyalarını topla, gidiyoruz.

    Pack your things, we're leaving.

    An Arabic plural (of şey) used as a singular noun, so eşyalar is common too. Ev eşyası = household goods, furniture.

    A1First taught in A1 · Unit 10: Whose is it?

  11. 711
    ilginçadjective

    interesting

    Çok ilginç bir kitap okudum.

    I read a very interesting book.

    From ilgi (interest); ilgilenmek = to be interested (in: -lA).

    A2

  12. 712
    dosyanoun

    file; folder

    Dosyayı sana e-postayla gönderdim.

    I sent you the file by email.

    A computer file, a paper folder, or a case file kept by the police or a hospital.

    A2

  13. 713
    temizlemekverb

    to clean

    Hafta sonu evi temizledik.

    We cleaned the house on the weekend.

    aorist temizler · present temizliyor · past temizledi · future temizleyecek

    The e becomes i before -(I)yor: temizliyor. From temiz (clean); temizlik = cleaning.

    A2First taught in A2 · Unit 1: The past tense

  14. 714
    hesapnoun

    bill, check (in a restaurant); account; calculation, sum

    Hesap, lütfen!

    The bill, please!

    accusative hesabı

    The p becomes b before a vowel: hesabı. Banka hesabı = bank account; hesap makinesi = calculator.

    A1First taught in A1 · Unit 12: Requests and company

  15. 715
    ileriadverb

    forward, ahead; further on; advanced

    Biraz daha ileri gidin.

    Go a little further.

    The opposite is geri. İleride = up ahead; in the future. İleri seviye = advanced level.

    A2First taught in A2 · Unit 9: Where and when: postpositions

  16. 716
    hedefnoun

    goal, aim; target

    Bu yılki hedefim Türkçe öğrenmek.

    My goal this year is to learn Turkish.

    Hedefine ulaşmak = to reach your goal. Amaç is a purpose.

    B1

  17. 717
    birçokdeterminer

    many, a lot of

    Birçok arkadaşım İstanbul'da yaşıyor.

    Many of my friends live in Istanbul.

    Written as one word, and followed by a singular noun: birçok insan, birçok kez.

    A2

  18. 718
    eğlenmekverb

    to have fun, to enjoy yourself; to make fun of (-lA)

    Partide çok eğlendik.

    We had a lot of fun at the party.

    aorist eğlenir · present eğleniyor · past eğlendi · future eğlenecek

    İyi eğlenceler! = Have fun! With -lA, to make fun of: Benimle eğlenme. Eğlenceli = fun.

    A2

  19. 719
    öğrencinoun

    student, pupil

    Kardeşim üniversite öğrencisi.

    My brother is a university student.

    From öğrenmek (to learn). Öğrenci indirimi = student discount.

    A1First taught in A1 · Unit 3: Saying who you are

  20. 720
    merkeznoun

    centre; head office

    Otel şehir merkezine çok yakın.

    The hotel is very close to the city centre.

    Şehir merkezi = city centre, downtown; alışveriş merkezi = shopping mall.

    A2

  21. 721
    elbisenoun

    dress; clothes (formal)

    Düğün için yeni bir elbise aldım.

    I bought a new dress for the wedding.

    A dress; in older or formal use, clothes in general. The everyday word for clothes is kıyafet.

    A2

  22. 722
    gayetadverb

    quite, very; perfectly

    Yemek gayet güzeldi.

    The food was really good.

    Before an adjective or an adverb: gayet iyi (perfectly fine). A bit more formal than çok.

    B1

  23. 723
    bağlıadjective

    depending on, up to (dative); tied, connected; attached, devoted (to)

    Bu sana bağlı.

    It's up to you.

    After the dative: Sana bağlı (It's up to you), Havaya bağlı (It depends on the weather). From bağlamak.

    B1

  24. 724
    bilgisayarnoun

    computer

    Bilgisayarım yine çalışmıyor.

    My computer isn't working again.

    Bilgi (information) + sayar (counter). A laptop is a dizüstü bilgisayar.

    A1First taught in A1 · Unit 2: Vowel harmony and plurals

  25. 725
    aciladjective

    urgent; emergency

    Acil bir durum var, hemen gel!

    It's an emergency, come right away!

    Acil servis = emergency room; acil durum = emergency. Not acele (hurry).

    B2First taught in B2 · Unit 10: As long as, unless, in case

  26. 726
    tıpkıadverb

    just like, exactly like

    Tıpkı annesine benziyor.

    She looks just like her mother.

    Strengthens gibi or benzemek: tıpkı senin gibi (just like you). Tıpatıp = exactly alike.

    B2First taught in B2 · Unit 2: As if

  27. 727
    zavallıadjective

    poor (to be pitied); wretched

    Zavallı kedi çok aç.

    The poor cat is very hungry.

    Poor as in pitiful: Zavallı çocuk! = Poor kid! Without money is fakir.

    B2First taught in B2 · Unit 9: Everyday colloquial Turkish

  28. 728
    soğukadjective

    cold

    Bir bardak soğuk su alabilir miyim?

    Can I have a glass of cold water?

    For things, the weather and distant people. For I'm cold, say Üşüyorum. Soğuk algınlığı = a cold.

    A1First taught in A1 · Unit 4: Questions and negation

  29. 729
    saldırmakverb

    to attack

    Köpek çocuğa saldırdı.

    The dog attacked the child.

    aorist saldırır · present saldırıyor · past saldırdı · future saldıracak

    The target takes the dative: bize saldırdılar. The noun is saldırı (attack).

    B1

  30. 730
    çiftnoun

    pair; couple; even (of a number)

    Yeni bir çift ayakkabı aldım.

    I bought a new pair of shoes.

    Bir çift ayakkabı = a pair of shoes; genç bir çift = a young couple. Çift sayı = even number; odd is tek.

    A2

  31. 731
    zekiadjective

    clever, intelligent

    Kızınız çok zeki.

    Your daughter is very clever.

    Close to akıllı. The noun is zekâ (intelligence), with â.

    A2

  32. 732
    dürüstadjective

    honest

    Bana karşı dürüst ol.

    Be honest with me.

    Dürüst olmak gerekirse = to be honest. Dürüstlük = honesty.

    A2

  33. 733
    makinenoun

    machine

    Çamaşır makinesi yine bozuldu.

    The washing machine broke down again.

    Çamaşır makinesi = washing machine, bulaşık makinesi = dishwasher, fotoğraf makinesi = camera.

    A2

  34. 734
    defanoun

    time (occasion)

    Bu filmi üç defa izledim.

    I've seen this movie three times.

    Same as kez and kere: ilk defa (for the first time), bir defa (once).

    A2

  35. 735
    düğünnoun

    wedding

    Düğün haziranda olacak.

    The wedding will be in June.

    The celebration; the marriage is evlilik, the civil ceremony nikâh.

    A2First taught in A2 · Unit 3: The future

  36. 736
    şaşırmakverb

    to be surprised; to be confused, to get mixed up

    Buna hiç şaşırmadım.

    I'm not surprised at all.

    aorist şaşırır · present şaşırıyor · past şaşırdı · future şaşıracak

    What surprises you takes the dative: Buna şaşırdım. Also to get confused: Yolu şaşırdım (I lost my way). Şaşırtmak = to surprise.

    A2First taught in A2 · Unit 2: Was, were, and once upon a time

  37. 737
    evliliknoun

    marriage

    Evlilik kolay bir şey değil.

    Marriage isn't an easy thing.

    accusative evliliği

    The k becomes ğ before a vowel: evliliği. From evli (married); evlenmek = to get married.

    A2

  38. 738
    bombanoun

    bomb

    Polis bombayı zamanında buldu.

    The police found the bomb in time.

    Colloquially, bomba gibi = sensational, stunning: bomba gibi bir haber.

    B1

  39. 739
    gösterinoun

    show, performance; demonstration (protest)

    Akşam parkta bir dans gösterisi var.

    There's a dance show in the park this evening.

    From göstermek (to show). A protest march is a gösteri yürüyüşü.

    B2First taught in B2 · Unit 2: As if

  40. 740
    tutuklamakverb

    to arrest

    Polis hırsızı dün tutukladı.

    The police arrested the thief yesterday.

    aorist tutuklar · present tutukluyor · past tutukladı · future tutuklayacak

    The a becomes u before -(I)yor: tutukluyor. Tutuklusunuz! = You're under arrest! Gözaltına almak = to take into custody.

    B1

  41. 741
    ziyaretnoun

    visit

    Hafta sonu dedemi ziyaret ettik.

    We visited my grandfather on the weekend.

    Ziyaret etmek = to visit, with the accusative: a person or a place. Ziyaretçi = visitor.

    B1First taught in B1 · Unit 6: Object participles

  42. 742
    sayınoun

    number; issue (of a magazine)

    Bir ile on arasında bir sayı seç.

    Pick a number between one and ten.

    A number in counting and math; a phone or house number is a numara.

    B2First taught in B2 · Unit 5: Formal Turkish

  43. 743
    amaçnoun

    aim, purpose, goal

    Amacım Türkçe konuşmak.

    My aim is to speak Turkish.

    accusative amacı

    The ç becomes c before a vowel: amacı. Amacıyla = with the aim of.

    B2First taught in B2 · Unit 5: Formal Turkish

  44. 744
    müşterinoun

    customer; client

    Dükkânda hiç müşteri yok.

    There are no customers in the shop.

    A shop's customer or a firm's client. Müşteri hizmetleri = customer service.

    A2

  45. 745
    ihtimalnoun

    possibility, chance, likelihood

    Büyük ihtimalle yarın gelir.

    He'll most likely come tomorrow.

    accusative ihtimali

    Front-vowel suffixes, because the l is a thin l: ihtimali, ihtimalle. Büyük ihtimalle = most likely.

    B2First taught in B2 · Unit 1: Unreal conditionals and wishes

  46. 746
    bacaknoun

    leg

    Futbol oynarken bacağım kırıldı.

    I broke my leg playing soccer.

    accusative bacağı

    The k becomes ğ before a vowel: bacağı. The foot is ayak.

    A2

  47. 747
    fenaadjective

    bad; badly, very (colloquial)

    Hava hiç fena değil.

    The weather isn't bad at all.

    Mostly in fena değil (not bad). Colloquially also really: Fena yoruldum (I'm dead tired). Otherwise kötü is the usual word.

    A2

  48. 748
    ayırmakverb

    to separate, to divide; to set aside, to save (for someone)

    Sana bir parça pasta ayırdım.

    I saved you a piece of cake.

    aorist ayırır · present ayırıyor · past ayırdı · future ayıracak

    To book: masa ayırtmak (to reserve a table). Ayrılmak = to leave; to split up.

    B1

  49. 749
    seçimnoun

    choice; election

    Bu senin seçimin.

    It's your choice.

    From seçmek (to choose). In the plural, often elections: seçimler.

    B2First taught in B2 · Unit 4: Noun clauses

  50. 750
    tercih etmekverb

    to prefer

    Çay mı tercih edersin, kahve mi?

    Would you prefer tea or coffee?

    aorist tercih eder · present tercih ediyor · past tercih etti · future tercih edecek

    What you prefer takes the accusative, what you prefer it to the dative: Çayı kahveye tercih ederim. Tercih = preference, choice.

    B1

  51. 751
    dişnoun

    tooth

    Yemekten sonra dişlerini fırçala.

    Brush your teeth after eating.

    Diş fırçası = toothbrush, diş macunu = toothpaste, dişçi or diş hekimi = dentist.

    B1First taught in B1 · Unit 10: Passive and reflexive

  52. 752
    karaadjective

    black, dark; gloomy, unlucky

    Kara bulutlar geliyor.

    Dark clouds are coming.

    Mostly in set phrases and figurative uses (kara haber, bad news; Karadeniz, the Black Sea); the usual colour word is siyah. The noun kara means land.

    B1

  53. 753
    karşılaşmakverb

    to run into, to meet (by chance); to come across, to face

    Dün markette eski bir arkadaşla karşılaştım.

    I ran into an old friend at the supermarket yesterday.

    aorist karşılaşır · present karşılaşıyor · past karşılaştı · future karşılaşacak

    Who or what you meet takes -lA: bir sorunla karşılaşmak (to come across a problem). A planned meeting is buluşmak.

    B2First taught in B2 · Unit 6: Compound verbs

  54. 754
    hisnoun

    feeling; sense

    İçimde kötü bir his var.

    I have a bad feeling.

    accusative hissi

    The s doubles before a vowel: hissi. Hissetmek = to feel; altıncı his = sixth sense.

    B1

  55. 755
    etkilemekverb

    to affect, to influence; to impress, to move

    Bu film beni çok etkiledi.

    This movie really moved me.

    aorist etkiler · present etkiliyor · past etkiledi · future etkileyecek

    The e becomes i before -(I)yor: etkiliyor. From etki (effect); etkileyici = impressive.

    B2First taught in B2 · Unit 10: As long as, unless, in case

  56. 756
    kokunoun

    smell, scent

    Mutfaktan güzel bir koku geliyor.

    There's a nice smell coming from the kitchen.

    Kokmak = to smell (of something): Burası balık kokuyor. Kokulu = scented.

    A2

  57. 757
    dairenoun

    apartment, flat; circle; office, department

    Üçüncü kattaki daire boş.

    The apartment on the third floor is empty.

    A flat in an apartman (apartment building). Also a circle, and a government office: vergi dairesi (tax office).

    A1First taught in A1 · Unit 10: Whose is it?

  58. 758
    iyileşmekverb

    to get better, to recover; to improve

    Annen iyileşti mi?

    Is your mother better?

    aorist iyileşir · present iyileşiyor · past iyileşti · future iyileşecek

    İyi + -lAş. Geçmiş olsun, çabuk iyileş! = Get well soon!

    B1First taught in B1 · Unit 11: Causative and reciprocal

  59. 759
    problemnoun

    problem

    Problem yok, ben hallederim.

    No problem, I'll take care of it.

    Same as sorun, the native word: Problem yok and Sorun değil both mean no problem.

    A1First taught in A1 · Unit 9: My family

  60. 760
    kuşnoun

    bird

    Sabah kuşların sesiyle uyandım.

    I woke up to the sound of birds this morning.

    Kuş uçmaz kervan geçmez = remote, in the middle of nowhere (literally, no bird flies and no caravan passes).

    B1First taught in B1 · Unit 9: Conditionals

  61. 761
    yollamakverb

    to send

    Fotoğrafları bana yollar mısın?

    Can you send me the photos?

    aorist yollar · present yolluyor · past yolladı · future yollayacak

    A colloquial göndermek. The a becomes u before -(I)yor: yolluyor.

    A2

  62. 762
    notnoun

    note; mark, grade (at school)

    Sınavdan iyi bir not aldım.

    I got a good mark on the exam.

    Not almak = to take notes, or to get a mark; not defteri = notebook.

    A2

  63. 763
    savaşmakverb

    to fight (in a war); to struggle (against)

    Yıllarca hastalıkla savaştı.

    She fought the illness for years.

    aorist savaşır · present savaşıyor · past savaştı · future savaşacak

    From savaş (war); the opponent takes -lA. A fistfight or a quarrel is kavga.

    C1First taught in C1 · Unit 2: -DIr: assumption and authority

  64. 764
    kırmızınoun

    red

    Kırmızı elbiseni giy.

    Wear your red dress.

    Like other colour words, both a noun and an adjective: kırmızı bir araba. Kırmızı ışık = red light.

    A1First taught in A1 · Unit 2: Vowel harmony and plurals

  65. 765
    cezanoun

    punishment, penalty; fine, ticket

    Polis bana ceza yazdı.

    The police gave me a ticket.

    Ceza yemek (colloquial) = to get a fine or a punishment; park cezası = parking ticket; cezaevi = prison.

    B1

  66. 766
    üniversitenoun

    university

    Kızım üniversitede tıp okuyor.

    My daughter is studying medicine at university.

    Üniversite okumak = to study at university; üniversiteli = university student.

    A2First taught in A2 · Unit 10: Compound nouns and -ki

  67. 767
    planlamakverb

    to plan

    Tatilimizi şimdiden planladık.

    We've already planned our vacation.

    aorist planlar · present planlıyor · past planladı · future planlayacak

    The a becomes ı before -(I)yor: planlıyor. Also plan yapmak.

    A2

  68. 768
    memurnoun

    civil servant, government employee; official, clerk

    Babam otuz yıl memur olarak çalıştı.

    My father worked as a civil servant for thirty years.

    Devlet memuru = civil servant. Memur bey = officer, a polite way to address a police officer.

    B1

  69. 769
    tarihnoun

    history; date

    Tarih benim en sevdiğim ders.

    History is my favourite subject.

    Both history and a date: doğum tarihi (date of birth), tarih öncesi (prehistory).

    B1First taught in B1 · Unit 7: Converbs I: when, by, without

  70. 770
    işaretnoun

    sign, signal; mark

    Bana el işareti yaptı.

    He signalled to me with his hand.

    İşaret etmek = to point (at), to signal; soru işareti = question mark; işaret dili = sign language.

    B1

  71. 771
    desteknoun

    support

    Desteğin için çok teşekkürler.

    Thanks a lot for your support.

    accusative desteği

    The k becomes ğ before a vowel: desteği. Destek olmak = to support, to stand by (dative): Sana destek olurum.

    B1

  72. 772
    özellikleadverb

    especially, particularly

    Türk yemeklerini, özellikle mantıyı çok severim.

    I love Turkish food, especially mantı.

    From özel (special) and özellik (feature).

    A2

  73. 773
    dilnoun

    language; tongue

    Kaç dil konuşuyorsun?

    How many languages do you speak?

    Both the organ and a language: yabancı dil (foreign language), ana dili (mother tongue). Names of languages end in -CA: Türkçe.

    B2First taught in B2 · Unit 1: Unreal conditionals and wishes

  74. 774
    sunmakverb

    to present; to offer, to provide; to serve (food, formal)

    Ayşe yarın projesini sunacak.

    Ayşe will present her project tomorrow.

    aorist sunar · present sunuyor · past sundu · future sunacak

    Formal: to present a report or a show, to offer a service (hizmet sunmak). Sunucu = TV host, presenter.

    B1

  75. 775
    birdenadverb

    suddenly; at once, all together

    Birden ışıklar söndü.

    Suddenly the lights went out.

    Also at once: hepsi birden (all of them at once). Aniden is a synonym.

    B1First taught in B1 · Unit 1: Past continuous and pluperfect

  76. 776
    sahnenoun

    scene; stage

    Filmin son sahnesi çok güzeldi.

    The last scene of the movie was beautiful.

    Sahneye çıkmak = to go on stage.

    B1First taught in B1 · Unit 6: Object participles

  77. 777
    karnoun

    snow

    Dün gece çok kar yağdı.

    It snowed a lot last night.

    Kar yağıyor = it's snowing; kardan adam = snowman. Not kâr (profit), written with â.

    A2First taught in A2 · Unit 2: Was, were, and once upon a time

  78. 778
    meşguladjective

    busy

    Şu an meşgulüm, sonra ararım.

    I'm busy right now, I'll call later.

    Front-vowel endings, because the l is a thin l (TDK): meşgulüm, meşguldü. Hat meşgul = the line is busy.

    A2First taught in A2 · Unit 5: Can and can't

  79. 779
    rağmenpostposition

    despite, in spite of

    Yağmura rağmen maça gittik.

    We went to the game despite the rain.

    After the dative: her şeye rağmen (in spite of everything). With a clause: -mAsInA rağmen.

    A2First taught in A2 · Unit 9: Where and when: postpositions

  80. 780
    yeteneknoun

    talent, gift; ability, skill

    Bu çocuğun müzik yeteneği var.

    This child has a talent for music.

    accusative yeteneği

    The k becomes ğ before a vowel: yeteneği. Yetenekli = talented.

    B2First taught in B2 · Unit 10: As long as, unless, in case

    yönnoun

    direction, way; side, aspect

    Ters yön = the opposite direction. Also an aspect: iyi yönleri (its good sides).

    B2First taught in B2 · Unit 1: Unreal conditionals and wishes

    Also said, half fondly, of a clever, mischievous person. Şeytanın avukatı = devil's advocate.

    gururnoun

    pride

    Seninle gurur duyuyorum.

    -lA gurur duymak = to be proud of. Gururlu = proud; sometimes vain.

    kaynaknoun

    The k becomes ğ before a vowel: kaynağı. Kaynak suyu = spring water. From kaynamak (to boil, to well up).

    With -lA: Annemle tartıştım (I argued with my mom). The noun is tartışma (argument, debate).

    The a becomes u before -(I)yor: zorluyor. What someone is forced into takes the dative: Beni gitmeye zorladı.

About this list

The words are ranked by how often they come up in film and TV dialogue, so the list leans towards spoken Turkish. Words are listed in their dictionary form (verbs in the infinitive, gelmek), names and fragments are left out, and ranks are estimates rather than exact counts.

The order of the list is adapted from the 2018 Turkish list of FrequencyWords by Hermit Dave, made from the OpenSubtitles2018 corpus via OPUS, and is licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0. The meanings, example sentences and notes are original to Daily Turkish.
